subject.title: fix(ai): remove Windows path heuristic that double-escapes JSON newlines

question: Should streaming JSON repair continue to preserve malformed raw Windows-path backslashes, or should OpenClaw intentionally accept only strict JSON escaping for those tool arguments?
rationale: The branch being removed encodes a compatibility choice for malformed model output, and the PR does not establish that the partial-parser fallback preserves the displaced behavior.

options.title: Retain malformed-path recovery
options.body: Revise the repair strategy so raw Windows paths remain literal while valid JSON newline escapes after path-like content still decode correctly, with regression tests for both.

options.title: Adopt strict JSON semantics
options.body: Remove the recovery behavior only after explicitly documenting that malformed raw Windows paths are unsupported and proving the affected provider/tool workflows do not rely on it.

recommendation.title: Retain malformed-path recovery
recommendation.body: Revise the repair strategy so raw Windows paths remain literal while valid JSON newline escapes after path-like content still decode correctly, with regression tests for both.
